TITLE: ASHES OF THE CHOSEN | EP.1 | The Invitation

[SCENE 1 - MOOD: romance_tension]
(Visual: Ada stands at the edge of the Lagos market at dusk, the small scar above her
left eyebrow catching the last light. Crowds blur past her, none of them looking.)
They told her the covenant died with her mother. Ada had learned by fourteen that
people say that when they want you to stop asking.

[SCENE 2 - MOOD: covenant_villain]
(Visual: Chief Obanla in his study, lamplight, a ledger open on the desk before him.)
The invitation arrived with no name on it. Only the seal. Obanla had seen that seal
once before, on the night he signed his own name and another woman's death.

[SCENE 3 - MOOD: supernatural]
(Visual: The compound gate at midnight, rust on the hinges, a single lamp burning
where no lamp should be.)
Ada did not knock. The gate opened before her hand touched it. Inside, the compound
smelled of rain that had not fallen in eleven years.

[SCENE 4 - MOOD: wilderness - FLASHBACK]
(Visual: Young Ada, twelve years old, barefoot on red earth, her mother's hand
closing around hers.)
Her mother had taught her the first word of the covenant in this exact spot. Say it
and the ground remembers you, she said. Say it twice and it comes looking.

[SCENE 5 - MOOD: revenge_power]
(Visual: Ada inside the compound now, the ledger in her hands, her jaw set.)
Every name in that book had eaten from her family's table. She read them slowly,
the way you read something you intend to answer for, and she did not stop until
she reached the last page.

[SCENE 6 - MOOD: romance_tension]
(Visual: Ada turns from the desk, ledger still open, and the door behind her is
already closing.)
The last name in the ledger was hers. Written in her own hand. Dated tomorrow.
